description: A function declaration declares a named function with a braced body, as JavaScript writes it
A function declaration is the same function as the def declaration with the same statements, so redeclaring it with either spelling updates its callers
Function declarations take the parenthesized parameters of def, with annotations, literal defaults and a final rest parameter
code:
function label(name: str, count = 1, ...tags) { return [name, count, tags] }
[label("a"), label("b", 2, "x", "y")]

description: In a class body a function declaration declares a method, and function init becomes the constructor
A function declaration may follow another statement on the same line and may start inside the body of another function
Function declarations are not hoisted, so a call that runs before the declaration raises a ReferenceError
Callers of a function declared with the function keyword follow its redeclaration, while its .value keeps the earlier definition
code:
function rate(x) { return x * 2 }
base = 3
charge = rate(base)
frozen = rate.value
function rate(x) { return x * 5 }
base = 4
[charge, frozen(base)]

description: A failed transaction rolls back a function declaration together with every value it updated
